prompt: Review the test design in test_release.py against release.py. Do not modify the fixture. Write findings.md with prioritized actionable findings, or state that there are none. Focus on whether positive tests remain deterministic after a real one-shot run has consumed its configured root.
expected_behavior: The review blocks approval because the positive test uses the shared production one-shot root and becomes order/external-state dependent after a real run; it recommends a fresh temporary root per test while retaining a separate pre-existing-root negative case.
failure_conditions: the shared production root in the positive test is not identified
the review does not explain failure after the root has been consumed
the review does not recommend per-test temporary root isolation
the pre-existing-root negative case is removed or conflated with the positive case
